onboarding.subtitle: A few quick questions so your targets actually fit you.

onboarding.aboutYouSubtitle: This builds your BMI and a real calorie estimate — not just a guess. Age and sex are only used for that calculation.
onboarding.labsNote: Add what you have — you can always do this later from Trends.

plan.messageHealthy: Your BMI is already in the healthy range — this plan is set to maintenance calories to help you stay there, not lose more.
plan.messageUnderweight: Your BMI is below the typical healthy range. This app won't suggest a calorie deficit here — talk to your doctor about a healthy weight gain plan tailored to you.
plan.messageDeficit: A gradual {{deficit}}-calorie-a-day reduction from your estimated maintenance is a safe pace — about {{kg}}kg ({{lb}}lb) a week toward a healthier BMI.

onboarding.disclaimer: This is a general estimate assuming the activity level you picked — not a diagnosis. Always confirm before changing your diet significantly, especially alongside diabetes medication.
onboarding.demoLabsSubtitle: If you have a recent result handy, add it now — you can always do this later from Trends.
onboarding.demoDisclaimer: This helps personalize your targets. Not a diagnosis — always confirm changes with your doctor.

labTrends.title: Your progress over time
labTrends.disclaimer: Target range reflects CDC National Diabetes Prevention Program benchmarks — not a diagnosis. Always confirm changes with your doctor.

trend.none: No {{metric}} readings yet — add your first one below to start tracking.

trend.firstLogged: Your first {{metric}} reading is logged. Add another down the road to start seeing a trend.
trend.droppedInRange: Your {{metric}} has dropped {{delta}} since your first reading — inside your target range.
trend.droppedTrending: Your {{metric}} has dropped {{delta}} since your first reading — trending in the right direction.
trend.risen: Your {{metric}} has risen {{delta}} since your first reading — worth a conversation with your doctor.
trend.steadyInRange: Your {{metric}} has held steady since your first reading, inside your target range.
trend.steady: Your {{metric}} has held steady since your first reading.

exercise.title: Today's activity
exercise.targetNote: Target reflects the CDC National Diabetes Prevention Program's 150 min/week activity benchmark, paced as ~30 min/day.

wellness.title: Rest and reset
wellness.sleepNote: Poor sleep makes blood sugar harder to manage — even a rough estimate helps you see the pattern.
wellness.stressNote: Chronic stress raises blood sugar too — a few minutes of any of these genuinely helps.

supplements.title: Track what you take
supplements.vdQuestion: Do you know your recent vitamin D level?
supplements.vdUnsureNote: Ask your doctor for a quick 25-hydroxyvitamin D blood test — it's simple and common, and it'll tell you the right dose instead of guessing.
supplements.trackAnyway: Track anyway without knowing my level →
supplements.vdLowNote: Use the dose your doctor prescribed for a low level, not the general maintenance amount.
